    90	async function applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme() {
    91	  if (Platform.OS !== "android") return;
    92	
    93	  try {
    94	    StatusBar.setHidden(false);
    95	    StatusBar.setBarStyle(androidStatusBarStyle, true);
    96	  } catch {}
    97	
    98	  try {
    99	    await NavigationBar.setVisibilityAsync("visible");
   100	  } catch {}
   101	
   102	  try {
   103	    await NavigationBar.setButtonStyleAsync(androidNavigationBarButtonStyle);
   104	  } catch {}
   105	}
   106	
   107	function AndroidNavigationBarTint({ dimStatusBar = false, pathname }) {
   108	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
   109	
   110	  useEffect(() => {
   111	    if (Platform.OS !== "android") return undefined;
   112	
   113	    const applyTheme = () => applyAndroidNavigationBarTheme();
   114	
   115	    applyTheme();
   116	    const restoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 250);
   117	    const finalRestoreTimer = setTimeout(applyTheme, 1000);
   118	    const appStateSubscription = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
   119	      if (state === "active") {
   120	        applyTheme();
   121	      }
   122	    });
   123	    let visibilitySubscription;
   124	
   125	    try {
   126	      visibilitySubscription = NavigationBar.addVisibilityListener(
   127	        applyTheme,
   128	      );
   129	    } catch {}
   130	
   131	    return () => {
   132	      clearTimeout(restoreTimer);
   133	      clearTimeout(finalRestoreTimer);
   134	      appStateSubscription.remove();
   135	      visibilitySubscription?.remove();
   136	    };
   137	  }, [dimStatusBar, pathname]);
   138	
   139	  if (Platform.OS !== "android" || insets.bottom <= 0) {
   140	    return null;
   141	  }
   142	
   143	  return (
   144	    <View
   145	      pointerEvents="none"
   146	      style={{
   147	        position: "absolute",
   148	        left: 0,
   149	        right: 0,
   150	        bottom: 0,
   151	        height: insets.bottom,
   152	        borderTopWidth: androidNavigationBarHairlineWidth,
   153	        borderTopColor: androidNavigationBarHairlineColor,
   154	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   155	        zIndex: 1000001,
   156	        elevation: 1000001,
   157	      }}
   158	    />
   159	  );
   160	}

   162	function AndroidStatusBarTint({ dimmed = false }) {
   163	  const height =
   164	    Platform.OS === "android" && Number.isFinite(StatusBar.currentHeight)
   165	      ? Math.max(0, StatusBar.currentHeight)
   166	      : 0;
   167	
   168	  if (height <= 0) {
   169	    return null;
   170	  }
   171	
   172	  return (
   173	    <View
   174	      pointerEvents="none"
   175	      style={{
   176	        position: "absolute",
   177	        top: 0,
   178	        left: 0,
   179	        right: 0,
   180	        height,
   181	        backgroundColor: androidNavigationBarColor,
   182	        zIndex: 1000002,
   183	        elevation: 1000002,
   184	      }}
   185	    >
   186	      {dimmed ? (
   187	        <View
   188	          pointerEvents="none"
   189	          style={{
   190	            position: "absolute",
   191	            top: 0,
   192	            right: 0,
   193	            bottom: 0,
   194	            left: 0,
   195	            backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
   196	          }}
   197	        />
   198	      ) : null}
   199	    </View>
   200	  );
   201	}

   219	function StartupSplashArtwork({ style = null }) {
   220	  const { width } = useWindowDimensions();
   221	  const iconScale = useRef(
   222	    new Animated.Value(startupSplashIconInitialScale),
   223	  ).current;
   224	  const iconSpin = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   225	  const iconMaskScale = useRef(
   226	    new Animated.Value(startupSplashIconMaskMaxScale),
   227	  ).current;
   228	  const iconSize = Math.min(
   229	    startupSplashIconMaxSize,
   230	    Math.max(startupSplashIconMinSize, width * 0.38),
   231	  );
   232	  const iconOuterRadius = iconSize * startupSplashIconOuterRadiusRatio;
   233	  const iconInnerInset = iconSize * startupSplashIconInnerInsetRatio;
   234	  const iconInnerSize = iconSize * startupSplashIconInnerSizeRatio;
   235	  const iconInnerRadius = iconInnerSize * startupSplashIconInnerRadiusRatio;
   236	  const iconBorderMaskSize = iconSize * startupSplashIconBorderMaskSizeRatio;
   237	  const iconBorderMaskOffset = (iconSize - iconBorderMaskSize) / 2;
   238	  const iconBorderMaskRadius =
   239	    iconBorderMaskSize * startupSplashIconOuterRadiusRatio;
   240	  const iconBorderMaskRotation = iconSpin.interpolate({
   241	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   242	    outputRange: ["0deg", "360deg"],
   243	  });
   244	
   245	  useEffect(() => {
   246	    const scaleAnimation = Animated.sequence([
   247	      Animated.timing(iconScale, {
   248	        toValue: startupSplashIconPeakScale,
   249	        duration: startupSplashIconEnlargeDuration,
   250	        easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic),
   251	        useNativeDriver: true,
   252	      }),
   253	      Animated.spring(iconScale, {
   254	        toValue: 1,
   255	        friction: 5,
   256	        tension: 90,
   257	        useNativeDriver: true,
   258	      }),
   259	    ]);
   260	    const spinAnimation = Animated.loop(
   261	      Animated.timing(iconSpin, {
   262	        toValue: 1,
   263	        duration: startupSplashIconSpinDuration,
   264	        easing: Easing.linear,
   265	        useNativeDriver: true,
   266	      }),
   267	    );
   268	    const maskPulseAnimation = Animated.loop(
   269	      Animated.sequence([
   270	        Animated.timing(iconMaskScale, {
   271	          toValue: startupSplashIconMaskMinScale,
   272	          duration: startupSplashIconMaskPulseDuration,
   273	          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
   274	          useNativeDriver: true,
   275	        }),
   276	        Animated.timing(iconMaskScale, {
   277	          toValue: startupSplashIconMaskMaxScale,
   278	          duration: startupSplashIconMaskPulseDuration,
   279	          easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad),
   280	          useNativeDriver: true,
   281	        }),
   282	      ]),
   283	    );
   284	
   285	    scaleAnimation.start();
   286	    spinAnimation.start();
   287	    maskPulseAnimation.start();
   288	
   289	    return () => {
   290	      scaleAnimation.stop();
   291	      spinAnimation.stop();
   292	      maskPulseAnimation.stop();
   293	      iconScale.stopAnimation();
   294	      iconSpin.stopAnimation();
   295	      iconMaskScale.stopAnimation();
   296	    };
   297	  }, [iconMaskScale, iconScale, iconSpin]);
   298	
   299	  return (
   300	    <View

   497	function RootLayoutContent({ headerScrollY, isStartupSplashReady }) {
   498	  const pathname = usePathname();
   499	  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
   500	  const [isStartupTutorialVisible, setIsStartupTutorialVisible] =
   501	    useState(true);
   502	  const [isStartupSplashDismissed, setIsStartupSplashDismissed] =
   503	    useState(false);
   504	  const startupTransitionProgress = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   505	  const backgroundHeroState = useBackgroundHeroState();
   506	  const {
   507	    cartOverlayActionRequest,
   508	    isQuestionOverlayVisible,
   509	    isShopOverlayVisible,
   510	  } = useShopCart();
   511	  const screenSwipe = useHeaderSwipe();
   512	  const topSafeInset = getTopSafeInset(insets);
   513	
   514	  const showPersistentHeader = pathname !== "/shop";
   515	
   516	  const useOverlayHeader =
   517	    pathname === "/" ||
   518	    pathname === "/products" ||
   519	    pathname === "/aboutus" ||
   520	    pathname === "/contact";
   521	
   522	  const shouldProtectBackgroundHero =
   523	    useOverlayHeader &&
   524	    Boolean(screenSwipe?.isActive || backgroundHeroState?.isFrozen);
   525	  const isShopQuestionOverlayVisible =
   526	    pathname === "/shop" && isQuestionOverlayVisible;
   527	  const backgroundHeroLayerDepth = shouldProtectBackgroundHero ? 100 : 0;
   528	  const screenFadeTopOffset = pathname === "/shop"
   529	    ? 120 + topSafeInset
   530	    : 84 + topSafeInset;
   531	  const shouldShowScreenFade =
   532	    !(pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible) &&
   533	    !isShopQuestionOverlayVisible;
   534	  const shouldShowCartOpeningDim =
   535	    cartOverlayActionRequest.pending && pathname !== "/shop";
   536	  const shouldDimAndroidStatusBar =
   537	    Platform.OS === "android" &&
   538	    ((pathname === "/shop" && isShopOverlayVisible) ||
   539	      isShopQuestionOverlayVisible);
   540	  const shouldShowStartupTutorial =
   541	    isStartupTutorialVisible && isStartupSplashReady;
   542	  const startupSplashOpacity = startupTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   543	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   544	    outputRange: [1, 0],
   545	  });
   546	  const handleStartupTutorialClose = useCallback(() => {
   547	    setIsStartupTutorialVisible(false);
   548	  }, []);
   549	
   550	  useEffect(() => {
   551	    if (!isStartupSplashReady || isStartupSplashDismissed) return undefined;
   552	
   553	    Animated.timing(startupTransitionProgress, {
   554	      toValue: 1,
   555	      duration: startupSplashFadeDuration,
   556	      easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic),
   557	      useNativeDriver: true,
   558	    }).start(({ finished }) => {
   559	      if (finished) {
   560	        setIsStartupSplashDismissed(true);
   561	      }
   562	    });
   563	
   564	    return () => {
   565	      startupTransitionProgress.stopAnimation();
   566	    };
   567	  }, [
   568	    isStartupSplashDismissed,
   569	    isStartupSplashReady,
   570	    startupTransitionProgress,
   571	  ]);
   572	
   573	  return (
   574	    <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: "#FFFCF2" }}>
   575	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   576	        <View
   577	          pointerEvents="none"
   578	          style={{
   579	            position: "absolute",
   580	            top: 0,
   581	            left: 0,
   582	            right: 0,
   583	            zIndex: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   584	            elevation: backgroundHeroLayerDepth,
   585	          }}
   586	        >
   587	          <AppHeader scrollY={headerScrollY} showOnlyHero />
   588	        </View>
   589	      ) : null}
   590	
   591	      <MainScreenPushFrame>
   592	        <Stack
   593	          screenOptions={{
   594	            headerShown: false,
   595	            animation: "none",
   596	            contentStyle: {
   597	              backgroundColor: useOverlayHeader
   598	                ? "transparent"
   599	                : "#FFFCF2",
   600	            },
   601	          }}
   602	        />
   603	      </MainScreenPushFrame>
   604	
   605	      {shouldShowScreenFade ? (
   606	        <ScreenFade
   607	          showTopFade={!useOverlayHeader}
   608	          topOffset={screenFadeTopOffset}
   609	        />
   610	      ) : null}
   611	
   612	      {showPersistentHeader && useOverlayHeader ? (
   613	        <View
   614	          pointerEvents="box-none"
   615	          style={{
   616	            position: "absolute",
   617	            top: 0,
   618	            left: 0,
   619	            right: 0,
   620	            zIndex: 1000000,
   621	            elevation: 1000000,
   622	          }}
   623	        >
   624	          <AppHeader
   625	            dimHeaderExceptShopButton={isShopQuestionOverlayVisible}
   626	            scrollY={headerScrollY}
   627	            showHero={false}
   628	          />
   629	        </View>
   630	      ) : null}
   631	
   632	      {showPersistentHeader && !useOverlayHeader ? (
   633	        <AppHeader
   634	          dimHeaderExceptShopButton={isShopQuestionOverlayVisible}
   635	          scrollY={headerScrollY}
   636	        />
   637	      ) : null}
   638	
   639	      {shouldShowCartOpeningDim ? (
   640	        <View
   641	          pointerEvents="none"
   642	          style={{
   643	            position: "absolute",
   644	            top: 0,
   645	            right: 0,
   646	            bottom: 0,
   647	            left: 0,
   648	            backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
   649	            zIndex: 1000001,
   650	            elevation: 1000001,
   651	          }}
   652	        />
   653	      ) : null}
   654	
   655	      <StickyCartButton />
   656	
   657	      <AndroidStatusBarTint
   658	        dimmed={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   659	      />
   660	      <AndroidNavigationBarTint
   661	        dimStatusBar={shouldDimAndroidStatusBar}
   662	        pathname={pathname}
   663	      />
   664	      <StartupTutorialOverlay
   665	        contentOpacity={startupTransitionProgress}
   666	        headerScrollY={headerScrollY}
   667	        onClose={handleStartupTutorialClose}
   668	        visible={shouldShowStartupTutorial}
   669	      />
   670	      <StartupIconSplash
   671	        opacity={startupSplashOpacity}
   672	        visible={!isStartupSplashDismissed}
   673	      />
   674	    </View>
   675	  );
   676	}
   677	
   678	export default function RootLayout() {
   679	  const headerScrollY = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
   680	  const [minimumSplashElapsed, setMinimumSplashElapsed] = useState(false);
   681	
   682	  const [fontsLoaded] = useFonts({
   683	    "Dream Avenue": require("../assets/fonts/dream_avenue/dream_avenue.ttf"),
   684	    "Great Vibes": require("../assets/fonts/great_vibes/GreatVibes-Regular.ttf"),
   685	    "TT Fors": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_regular.ttf"),
   686	    "TT Fors Demibold": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_demibold.ttf"),
   687	    "TT Fors Black": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_black.ttf"),
   688	    "TT Fors Light": require("../assets/fonts/tt_fors/tt_fors_trial_light.ttf"),
   689	  });
   690	
   691	  useEffect(() => {
   692	    const minimumSplashTimer = setTimeout(() => {
   693	      setMinimumSplashElapsed(true);
   694	    }, startupSplashMinimumDuration);
   695	
   696	    return () => {
   697	      clearTimeout(minimumSplashTimer);
   698	    };
   699	  }, []);
   700	
   701	  const isStartupSplashReady = fontsLoaded && minimumSplashElapsed;
   702	
   703	  if (!fontsLoaded) {
   704	    return <StartupSplashArtwork />;
   705	  }
   706	
   707	  return (
   708	    <SafeAreaProvider>
   709	      <StripeProvider
   710	        merchantIdentifier={stripeMerchantIdentifier || undefined}
   711	        publishableKey={stripePublishableKey}
   712	        setReturnUrlSchemeOnAndroid
   713	        urlScheme={stripeUrlScheme}
   714	      >
   715	        <ThemeProvider value={navigationTheme}>
   716	          <HeaderScrollProvider scrollY={headerScrollY}>
   717	            <BackgroundHeroStateProvider sourceScrollY={headerScrollY}>
   718	              <HeaderSwipeProvider>
   719	                <ShopCartProvider>
   720	                  <RootLayoutContent
   721	                    headerScrollY={headerScrollY}
   722	                    isStartupSplashReady={isStartupSplashReady}
   723	                  />
   724	                </ShopCartProvider>
   725	              </HeaderSwipeProvider>
   726	            </BackgroundHeroStateProvider>
   727	          </HeaderScrollProvider>
   728	        </ThemeProvider>
   729	      </StripeProvider>
   730	    </SafeAreaProvider>
   731	  );
   732	}

    31	function isMatchingLayout(currentLayout, nextLayout) {
    32	  return (
    33	    currentLayout &&
    34	    Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
    35	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
    36	  );
    37	}

   194	function ProductMagnifySection({ croppedImageWidth, onBuyPress, product, scrollY }) {
   195	  const [buyButtonLayout, setBuyButtonLayout] = useState(null);
   196	  const [imageLayout, setImageLayout] = useState(null);
   197	  const [lowerContentLayout, setLowerContentLayout] = useState(null);
   198	
   199	  const updateLayout = useCallback((setter) => ({ nativeEvent }) => {
   200	    const nextLayout = nativeEvent.layout;
   201	
   202	    setter((currentLayout) => {
   203	      if (
   204	        currentLayout &&
   205	        Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
   206	        Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5
   207	      ) {
   208	        return currentLayout;
   209	      }
   210	
   211	      return nextLayout;
   212	    });
   213	  }, []);
   214	
   215	  return (
   216	    <CenterMagnifyView
   217	      magnifyEnterAnchorLayout={imageLayout}
   218	      magnifyExitAnchorLayout={buyButtonLayout || lowerContentLayout}
   219	      scrollY={scrollY}
   220	      style={productsStyles.productSectionWrap}
   221	    >
   222	      <ProductSection
   223	        croppedImageWidth={croppedImageWidth}
   224	        onBuyButtonLayout={updateLayout(setBuyButtonLayout)}
   225	        onBuyPress={onBuyPress}
   226	        onImageLayout={updateLayout(setImageLayout)}
   227	        onLowerContentLayout={updateLayout(setLowerContentLayout)}
   228	        product={product}
   229	      />
   230	    </CenterMagnifyView>
   231	  );
   232	}

    17	function isMatchingLayout(currentLayout, nextLayout) {
    18	  return (
    19	    currentLayout &&
    20	    Math.abs(currentLayout.y - nextLayout.y) < 0.5 &&
    21	    Math.abs(currentLayout.height - nextLayout.height) < 0.5

    81	  };
    82	
    83	  const markFieldBlurred = (fieldKey) => {
    84	    const fieldValue = contactFieldValues[fieldKey] || "";
    85	
    86	    setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
    87	      ...currentFieldKeys,
    88	      [fieldKey]: true,
    89	    }));
    90	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
    91	      const isFieldEmpty = fieldValue.trim().length === 0;
    92	
    93	      if (isFieldEmpty) {
    94	        return {
    95	          ...currentFieldKeys,
    96	          [fieldKey]: true,
    97	        };
    98	      }
    99	
   100	      if (!currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
   101	        return currentFieldKeys;
   102	      }
   103	
   104	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
   105	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
   106	      return nextFieldKeys;
   107	    });
   108	  };
   109	
   110	  const updateContactField = (fieldKey, text, setter) => {
   111	    setter(text);
   112	    setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => {
   113	      if (text.trim().length === 0 || !currentFieldKeys[fieldKey]) {
   114	        return currentFieldKeys;
   115	      }
   116	
   117	      const nextFieldKeys = { ...currentFieldKeys };
   118	      delete nextFieldKeys[fieldKey];
   119	      return nextFieldKeys;
   120	    });
   121	  };
   122	
   123	  const showContactAlert = (title, alertMessage) => {
   124	    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && typeof window.alert === "function") {
   125	      window.alert(`${title}\n${alertMessage}`);
   126	      return;
   127	    }
   128	
   129	    Alert.alert(title, alertMessage);
   130	  };
   131	
   132	  const handleSubmit = async () => {
   133	    if (!canSubmit) {
   134	      setBlurredFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   135	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   136	        email: true,
   137	      }));
   138	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys((currentFieldKeys) => ({
   139	        ...currentFieldKeys,
   140	        ...(trimmedName.length === 0 ? { name: true } : {}),
   141	        ...(trimmedEmail.length === 0 ? { email: true } : {}),
   142	        ...(trimmedMessage.length === 0 ? { message: true } : {}),
   143	      }));
   144	      setStatusMessage("Please enter your name, email, and message.");
   145	      return;
   146	    }
   147	
   148	    setIsSending(true);
   149	    setStatusMessage("");
   150	
   151	    try {
   152	      await sendContactMessage({
   153	        email: trimmedEmail,
   154	        message: trimmedMessage,
   155	        name: trimmedName,
   156	        phone: phone.trim(),
   157	      });
   158	      setName("");
   159	      setEmail("");
   160	      setPhone("");
   161	      setMessage("");
   162	      setBlurredFieldKeys({});
   163	      setEmptyTouchedFieldKeys({});
   164	      setStatusMessage("Message sent. We will respond within 48 hours.");
   165	      showContactAlert(
   166	        "Message sent",
   167	        "Thank you. Your message was sent to Alla Vostra.",
   168	      );
   169	    } catch (error) {
   170	      const errorMessage = error?.message || "Please try again.";
   171	      setStatusMessage(errorMessage);
   172	      showContactAlert("Message not sent", errorMessage);
   173	    } finally {
   174	      setIsSending(false);
   175	    }
   176	  };
   177	
   178	  return (
   179	    <View style={contactStyles.screen} {...screenSwipeHandlers}>
   180	      <Animated.ScrollView
   181	        style={contactStyles.scroll}
   182	        contentContainerStyle={[
   183	          contactStyles.scrollContent,
   184	          scrollContentInsetStyle,
   185	        ]}
   186	        contentOffset={initialContentOffset}
   187	        decelerationRate={0.95}
   188	        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
   189	        scrollEventThrottle={16}
   190	        {...getMainScreenScrollViewProps()}
   191	        {...screenSwipeHandlers}
   192	        {...scrollHandlers}
   193	      >
   194	        <View style={contactStyles.main}>
   195	          <MainScreenIntroSpacer
   196	            compactTopLayout={compactTopLayout}
   197	            pageTitleStyle={contactStyles.pageTitle}
   198	            scrollY={scrollY}
   199	          />
   200	
   201	          <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   202	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>Got a business inquiry?</Text>
   203	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   204	              General questions about our products?
   205	            </Text>
   206	            <Text style={contactStyles.introText}>
   207	              We strive to respond within 48 hours.
   208	            </Text>
   209	          </CenterMagnifyView>
   210	
   211	          <View style={contactStyles.formCard}>
   212	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   213	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Full Name</Text>
   214	              <TextInput
   215	                ref={(inputNode) => {
   216	                  contactInputRefs.current.name = inputNode;
   217	                }}
   218	                style={[
   219	                  contactStyles.input,
   220	                  shouldShowFieldFault("name") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   221	                ]}
   222	                placeholder="Your Name"
   223	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   224	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("name")}
   225	                onChangeText={(text) => updateContactField("name", text, setName)}
   226	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("name")}
   227	                returnKeyType="next"
   228	                textContentType="name"
   229	                value={name}
   230	              />
   231	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   232	
   233	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   234	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Email Address</Text>
   235	              <TextInput
   236	                ref={(inputNode) => {
   237	                  contactInputRefs.current.email = inputNode;
   238	                }}
   239	                style={[
   240	                  contactStyles.input,
   241	                  shouldShowFieldFault("email") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   242	                ]}
   243	                placeholder="you@company.com"
   244	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   245	                keyboardType="email-address"
   246	                autoCapitalize="none"
   247	                autoCorrect={false}
   248	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("email")}
   249	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   250	                  updateContactField("email", text, setEmail)
   251	                }
   252	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("email")}
   253	                returnKeyType="next"
   254	                textContentType="emailAddress"
   255	                value={email}
   256	              />
   257	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   258	
   259	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   260	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Phone Number</Text>
   261	              <TextInput
   262	                {...getTextInputKeyboardProps({
   263	                  fieldKey: "phone",
   264	                  keyboardType: "phone-pad",
   265	                })}
   266	                style={[
   267	                  contactStyles.input,
   268	                  shouldShowFieldFault("phone") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   269	                ]}
   270	                placeholder="+1 (555) 1234-567"
   271	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   272	                onBlur={() => {
   273	                  setIsPhoneInputFocused(false);
   274	                  markFieldBlurred("phone");
   275	                }}
   276	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   277	                  updateContactField("phone", text, setPhone)
   278	                }
   279	                onFocus={() => {
   280	                  setIsPhoneInputFocused(true);
   281	                  clearFieldFault("phone");
   282	                }}
   283	                returnKeyType="next"
   284	                ref={(inputNode) => {
   285	                  contactInputRefs.current.phone = inputNode;
   286	                }}
   287	                value={phone}
   288	              />
   289	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   290	
   291	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY}>
   292	              <Text style={contactStyles.label}>Your Message</Text>
   293	              <TextInput
   294	                ref={(inputNode) => {
   295	                  contactInputRefs.current.message = inputNode;
   296	                }}
   297	                style={[
   298	                  contactStyles.input,
   299	                  contactStyles.messageInput,
   300	                  shouldShowFieldFault("message") && contactStyles.inputFaulty,
   301	                ]}
   302	                placeholder="Your Message"
   303	                placeholderTextColor="rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.38)"
   304	                multiline
   305	                onBlur={() => markFieldBlurred("message")}
   306	                onChangeText={(text) =>
   307	                  updateContactField("message", text, setMessage)
   308	                }
   309	                onFocus={() => clearFieldFault("message")}
   310	                returnKeyType="default"
   311	                textAlignVertical="top"
   312	                value={message}
   313	              />
   314	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   315	
   316	            <CenterMagnifyView scrollY={scrollY} style={contactStyles.buttonWrap}>
   317	              <HapticPressable
   318	                accessibilityRole="button"
   319	                disabled={isSending}
   320	                onPress={handleSubmit}
   321	                style={({ pressed }) => [
   322	                  contactStyles.button,
   323	                  (!canSubmit || pressed) && contactStyles.buttonDimmed,
   324	                ]}
   325	              >
   326	                <Text style={contactStyles.buttonText}>
   327	                  {isSending ? "Sending..." : "Send Message"}
   328	                </Text>
   329	              </HapticPressable>
   330	              {statusMessage ? (
   331	                <Text style={contactStyles.statusText}>{statusMessage}</Text>
   332	              ) : null}
   333	            </CenterMagnifyView>
   334	          </View>
   335	        </View>
   336	      </Animated.ScrollView>
   337	      <IOSKeyboardAccessory
   338	        onNext={() => focusContactField("message")}
   339	        onPrevious={() => focusContactField("email")}
   340	        visible={Platform.OS === "ios" && isPhoneInputFocused}
   341	      />
   342	    </View>
   343	  );
   344	}

   786	function getStripeCardBrandLabel(brand) {
   787	  switch (brand) {
   788	    case "Visa":
   789	      return "VISA";
   790	    case "MasterCard":
   791	      return "MASTERCARD";
   792	    case "AmericanExpress":
   793	      return "AMEX";
   794	    case "Unknown":
   795	    case undefined:
   796	    case null:
   797	      return "";
   798	    default:
   799	      return String(brand)
   800	        .replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2")
   801	        .toUpperCase();
   802	  }
   803	}
   804	
   805	const normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits = (text, maxLength) =>
   806	  String(text || "")
   807	    .replace(/\D/g, "")
   808	    .slice(0, maxLength);
   809	
   810	function formatPaymentCardFallbackValue(fieldKey, text) {
   811	  if (fieldKey === "number") {
   812	    return normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 19)
   813	      .replace(/(.{4})/g, "$1 ")
   814	      .trim();
   815	  }
   816	
   817	  if (fieldKey === "expiration") {
   818	    const digits = normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 4);
   819	
   820	    return digits.length > 2
   821	      ? `${digits.slice(0, 2)}/${digits.slice(2)}`
   822	      : digits;
   823	  }
   824	
   825	  if (fieldKey === "cvc") {
   826	    return normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 4);
   827	  }
   828	
   829	  if (fieldKey === "postalCode") {
   830	    return normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(text, 5);
   831	  }
   832	
   833	  return text;
   834	}
   835	
   836	function getPaymentCardFallbackStripeBrand(number) {
   837	  const digits = normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(number, 19);
   838	  const firstTwoDigits = Number(digits.slice(0, 2));
   839	  const firstFourDigits = Number(digits.slice(0, 4));
   840	
   841	  if (digits.startsWith("4")) {
   842	    return "Visa";
   843	  }
   844	
   845	  if (digits.startsWith("34") || digits.startsWith("37")) {
   846	    return "AmericanExpress";
   847	  }
   848	
   849	  if (
   850	    (firstTwoDigits >= 51 && firstTwoDigits <= 55) ||
   851	    (firstFourDigits >= 2221 && firstFourDigits <= 2720)
   852	  ) {
   853	    return "MasterCard";
   854	  }
   855	
   856	  return "Unknown";
   857	}
   858	
   859	function getNormalizedPaymentCardFallbackValues(values) {
   860	  return {
   861	    cvc: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.cvc, 4),
   862	    expiration: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.expiration, 4),
   863	    number: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.number, 19),
   864	    postalCode: normalizePaymentCardFallbackDigits(values.postalCode, 5),
   865	  };
   866	}
   867	
   868	function isPaymentCardFallbackComplete(values) {
   869	  const normalizedValues = getNormalizedPaymentCardFallbackValues(values);
   870	  const expirationMonth = Number(normalizedValues.expiration.slice(0, 2));
   871	
   872	  return (
   873	    normalizedValues.number.length >= 12 &&
   874	    normalizedValues.expiration.length === 4 &&
   875	    expirationMonth >= 1 &&
   876	    expirationMonth <= 12 &&
   877	    normalizedValues.cvc.length >= 3 &&
   878	    normalizedValues.postalCode.length >= 5
   879	  );
   880	}

  1110	function PiccolaQuantityTriangle({ direction, muted }) {
  1111	  const strokeInset = piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleStrokeWidth / 2;
  1112	  const strokeColor = muted ? "#888888" : "#111111";
  1113	  const isUpTriangle = direction === "up";
  1114	  const fillGradientId = isUpTriangle
  1115	    ? "piccolaQuantityTriangleTopGradient"
  1116	    : "piccolaQuantityTriangleBottomGradient";
  1117	  const fillGradientColors = isUpTriangle
  1118	    ? topOverlayGradientColors
  1119	    : orangeButtonGradientColors;
  1120	  const path =
  1121	    isUpTriangle
  1122	      ? [
  1123	          `M ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2} ${strokeInset}`,
  1124	          `L ${
  1125	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth - strokeInset
  1126	          } ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset}`,
  1127	          `L ${strokeInset} ${
  1128	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset
  1129	          }`,
  1130	          "Z",
  1131	        ].join(" ")
  1132	      : [
  1133	          `M ${strokeInset} ${strokeInset}`,
  1134	          `L ${
  1135	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth - strokeInset
  1136	          } ${strokeInset}`,
  1137	          `L ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2} ${
  1138	            piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight - strokeInset
  1139	          }`,
  1140	          "Z",
  1141	        ].join(" ");
  1142	
  1143	  return (
  1144	    <Svg
  1145	      height="100%"
  1146	      style={shopStyles.piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleSvg}
  1147	      viewBox={`0 0 ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth} ${piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight}`}
  1148	      width="100%"
  1149	    >
  1150	      <Defs>
  1151	        <SvgLinearGradient
  1152	          gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
  1153	          id={fillGradientId}
  1154	          x1={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2}
  1155	          x2={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleWidth / 2}
  1156	          y1={isUpTriangle ? piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight : 0}
  1157	          y2={isUpTriangle ? 0 : piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleHeight}
  1158	        >
  1159	          {fillGradientColors.map((color, index) => (
  1160	            <Stop
  1161	              key={`${fillGradientId}-${color}`}
  1162	              offset={`${index * 50}%`}
  1163	              stopColor={color}
  1164	            />
  1165	          ))}
  1166	        </SvgLinearGradient>
  1167	      </Defs>
  1168	      <Path
  1169	        d={path}
  1170	        fill={`url(#${fillGradientId})`}
  1171	        opacity={muted ? 0.5 : 1}
  1172	        stroke={strokeColor}
  1173	        strokeLinejoin="round"
  1174	        strokeWidth={piccolaOverlayQuantityTriangleStrokeWidth}
  1175	      />
  1176	    </Svg>
  1177	  );
  1178	}

  2181	  const shouldIgnoreProgrammaticDeliveryTimeWheelEvent = (fieldKey) =>

  2183	    Date.now() <
  2184	      (deliveryTimeWheelProgrammaticBlockedUntilRef.current[fieldKey] || 0);

  2292	  const stepDeliveryTimeWheelValue = (fieldKey, options, direction) => {
  2293	    if (!options.length) {
  2294	      return;
  2295	    }
  2296	
  2297	    const currentValue =
  2298	      deliveryFieldValues[fieldKey] ||
  2299	      defaultDeliveryFieldValues[fieldKey] ||
  2300	      options[0];
  2301	    const currentIndex = Math.max(0, options.indexOf(currentValue));
  2302	    const currentLoopedIndex =
  2303	      deliveryTimeWheelVisibleIndexesRef.current[fieldKey] ??
  2304	      deliveryTimeWheelVisibleIndexes[fieldKey] ??
  2305	      getDeliveryTimeWheelLoopedIndex(options, currentIndex);

  2307	      deliveryTimeWheelLoopCount * options.length - 1,
  2308	      Math.max(0, currentLoopedIndex + direction),

  2311	      ((nextLoopedIndex % options.length) + options.length) % options.length;

  2336	  const beginDeliveryTimeWheelSwipe = (fieldKey, pageY) => {

  2350	  const releaseDeliveryTimeWheelSwipe = (fieldKey, options, pageY) => {
  2351	    const startY = deliveryTimeWheelTouchStartYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2352	    const endY = Number.isFinite(pageY)
  2353	      ? pageY
  2354	      : deliveryTimeWheelTouchCurrentYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2355	    delete deliveryTimeWheelTouchStartYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2356	    delete deliveryTimeWheelTouchCurrentYRef.current[fieldKey];
  2357	
  2358	    if (!Number.isFinite(startY) || !Number.isFinite(endY)) {
  2359	      return;
  2360	    }
  2361	
  2362	    const deltaY = endY - startY;
  2363	
  2364	    if (Math.abs(deltaY) < deliveryTimeWheelSwipeThreshold) {
  2365	      return;
  2366	    }
  2367	
  2368	    const stepCount = Math.max(
  2369	      1,
  2370	      Math.min(3, Math.round(Math.abs(deltaY) / 28)),
  2371	    );
  2372	    stepDeliveryTimeWheelValue(
  2373	      fieldKey,
  2374	      options,
  2375	      deltaY < 0 ? stepCount : -stepCount,
  2376	    );
  2377	  };

    94	function getActivePageFromPath(pathname) {
    95	  if (pathname === "/products") return "products";
    96	  if (pathname === "/aboutus") return "aboutus";
    97	  if (pathname === "/contact") return "contact";
    98	  if (pathname === "/shop") return "shop";
    99	  return "home";
   100	}
   101	
   102	function getNavigationDirection(fromPage, toPage) {
   103	  const fromIndex = navPages.indexOf(fromPage);
   104	  const toIndex = navPages.indexOf(toPage);
   105	
   106	  if (fromIndex < 0 || toIndex < 0 || fromIndex === toIndex) return 1;
   107	
   108	  const lastPageIndex = navPages.length - 1;
   109	
   110	  if (fromIndex === lastPageIndex && toIndex === 0) return 1;
   111	  if (fromIndex === 0 && toIndex === lastPageIndex) return -1;
   112	
   113	  return toIndex > fromIndex ? 1 : -1;
   114	}

   500	          startDirectionalArrowLinger("right");
   501	          goToPage(previousPage, true, -1);
   502	
   503	          return;
   504	        }
   505	
   506	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   507	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   508	      },
   509	
   510	      onPanResponderTerminate: () => {
   511	        suppressCarouselPressUntilRef.current = Date.now() + 500;
   512	        hideHeldArrows();
   513	        clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   514	        screenSwipe?.clearSwipe({ animate: true });
   515	      },
   516	
   517	      onShouldBlockNativeResponder: () => true,
   518	    })
   519	  ).current;
   520	
   521	  useEffect(() => {
   522	    hideHeldArrows();
   523	
   524	    return () => {
   525	      hideHeldArrows();
   526	    };
   527	  }, [resolvedActivePage, showCarousel, showOnlyHero]);
   528	
   529	  useEffect(
   530	    () => () => {
   531	      clearDirectionalArrowLinger();
   532	    },
   533	    []
   534	  );
   535	
   536	  const activeLink = pageLabels[resolvedActivePage] || "Home";
   537	  const arrowLinkTranslateX = 0;
   538	
   539	  const scrollBeganArrowVisibility = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   540	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   541	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   542	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   543	  });
   544	  const oldHeaderArrowVisibility = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   545	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   546	    outputRange: [1, 0],
   547	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   548	  });
   549	  const oldHeaderHeldArrowOpacity = Animated.multiply(
   550	    heldArrowOpacity.interpolate({
   551	      inputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   552	      outputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   553	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   554	    }),
   555	    oldHeaderArrowVisibility
   556	  );

   558	    scrollBeganArrowVisibility,
   559	    arrowHintPeakOpacity
   560	  );

   562	    heldArrowOpacity,
   563	    scrolledStateArrowOpacity

   567	      inputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   568	      outputRange: [0, arrowHintPeakOpacity],
   569	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   570	    }),
   571	    scrollBeganArrowVisibility
   572	  );

   574	    oldHeaderHeldArrowOpacity,
   575	    gatedScrolledArrowOpacity

   577	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   578	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   579	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   580	  });

   583	    directionalArrowBaseSuppression.interpolate({
   584	      inputRange: [0, 1],
   585	      outputRange: [1, 0],
   586	      extrapolate: "clamp",
   587	    })

   591	    directionalLeftArrowOpacity

   594	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   595	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   596	  });

   598	    directionalBaseArrowOpacity,
   599	    directionalRightArrowOpacity

   602	    outputRange: [0, 1],
   603	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   604	  });

   606	  const heroVerticalFadeTranslateY = resolvedHeroMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   607	    inputRange: [0, heroVerticalFadeScrollDistance],

   610	  });

   614	      ? 0

   616	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   617	          outputRange: [0, carouselStickyOffsetY],
   618	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   619	        });

   621	    Platform.OS === "ios"
   622	      ? resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   623	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   624	          outputRange: [0, carouselExpansionHeight],
   625	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   626	        })
   627	      : stickyOffset;
   628	  const carouselInnerTranslateY = carouselExpansionOffsetY;
   629	  const centerShadowOpacity =
   630	    Platform.OS === "web"

   632	      : resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   633	          inputRange: [96, 120],
   634	          outputRange: [0, 1],
   635	          extrapolate: "clamp",
   636	        });
   637	
   638	  const stickyExpansionTranslateY = resolvedHeaderMotionScrollY.interpolate({
   639	    inputRange: [96, 120],
   640	    outputRange: [-stickyExpansionMaxHeight, 0],

   651	    inputRange: [0, heroFadeScrollDistance],
   652	    outputRange: [heroStartTranslateY, heroTranslateYAtMinimumOpacity],

   710	  const cheeseboardHeight = cheeseboardSourceHeight * heroLayoutScale;
   711	  const cheeseboardLeft =

   723	  const isCheeseboardSwipeActive =
   724	    isMainHeroPage &&
   725	    !isCheeseboardNavigationMotionDisabled &&
   726	    Boolean(screenSwipe?.isActive);
   727	  const cheeseboardTransitionDirection =
   728	    routeTransitionState?.direction === -1 ? -1 : 1;

   731	      ? routeTransitionState.startX
   732	      : 0;
   733	  const cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX =
   734	    Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0.01 : 0;
   735	  const cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX =
   736	    Math.abs(cheeseboardTransitionStartX) > 0.01
   737	      ? cheeseboardTransitionStartX
   738	      : cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX;
   739	  const cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity =
   740	    Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0.001 : 0;
   741	  const cheeseboardDragTranslateX = isCheeseboardSwipeActive
   742	    ? screenSwipe?.swipeX || 0
   743	    : 0;
   744	  const cheeseboardBaseTranslateX = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   745	    ? 0
   746	    : cheeseboardDragTranslateX;
   747	  const cheeseboardBaseOpacity = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   748	    ? routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   749	        inputRange: [0, 0.92, 1],
   750	        outputRange: [
   751	          cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity,
   752	          cheeseboardHiddenHandoffOpacity,
   753	          1,
   754	        ],
   755	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   756	      })
   757	    : 1;
   758	  const cheeseboardOutgoingTranslateX = isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive
   759	    ? routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   760	        inputRange: [0, 1],
   761	        outputRange: [
   762	          cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX,
   763	          -cheeseboardTransitionDirection * windowWidth,
   764	        ],
   765	        extrapolate: "clamp",
   766	      })
   767	    : cheeseboardDragTranslateX;
   768	  const cheeseboardIncomingTranslateX = routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   769	    inputRange: [0, 1],
   770	    outputRange: [
   771	      cheeseboardTransitionStartTranslateX +
   772	        cheeseboardTransitionDirection * windowWidth,
   773	      cheeseboardCenteredMotionTranslateX,
   774	    ],
   775	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   776	  });
   777	  const cheeseboardIncomingOpacity = routeTransitionProgress.interpolate({
   778	    inputRange: [0, 0.92, 1],
   779	    outputRange: [1, 1, 0],
   780	    extrapolate: "clamp",
   781	  });
   782	  const cheeseboardPreviousPreviewTranslateX = screenSwipe?.swipeX
   783	    ? Animated.add(screenSwipe.swipeX, -windowWidth)
   784	    : -windowWidth;
   785	  const cheeseboardNextPreviewTranslateX = screenSwipe?.swipeX
   786	    ? Animated.add(screenSwipe.swipeX, windowWidth)
   787	    : windowWidth;
   788	  const shouldShowCheeseboardDragPreviews =
   789	    isMainHeroPage &&
   790	    isCheeseboardSwipeActive &&
   791	    !isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive;
   792	  const handleCarouselTouchStart = (event) => {
   793	    showHeldArrows(event);
   794	    return false;
   795	  };

   797	  const sharedHeaderTouchHandlers = {
   798	    onStartShouldSetResponderCapture: handleCarouselTouchStart,
   799	    onTouchStart: showHeldArrows,
   800	    onTouchMove: updateHeldArrowsFromTouchMove,
   801	    onTouchEnd: hideHeldArrows,
   802	    onTouchCancel: hideHeldArrows,
   803	  };
   804	
   805	  const renderArrowChevron = (direction) => (
   806	    <View
   807	      style={[
   808	        styles.arrowChevron,
   809	        direction === "left"
   810	          ? styles.arrowChevronLeft
   811	          : styles.arrowChevronRight,
   812	      ]}
   813	    />
   814	  );
   815

   817	    const slideTransformStyle =
   818	      translateX === 0 ? null : { transform: [{ translateX }] };
   819	    const resolvedSlideOpacity =
   820	      isMainHeroPage && opacity !== 1
   821	        ? Animated.multiply(opacity, mainHeroVisualOpacity)

   823	        ? mainHeroVisualOpacity
   824	        : opacity;
   825	    const slideOpacityStyle =
   826	      resolvedSlideOpacity === 1 ? null : { opacity: resolvedSlideOpacity };

   828	    return (
   829	      <Animated.View
   830	        key={key}
   831	        collapsable={false}
   832	        pointerEvents="none"
   833	        renderToHardwareTextureAndroid
   834	        style={[
   835	          styles.cheeseboardSlideLayer,
   836	          slideTransformStyle,
   837	          slideOpacityStyle,

   839	      >
   840	        <Animated.View
   841	          collapsable={false}
   842	          style={styles.cheeseboardHeroTransformLayer}
   843	        >
   844	          <Animated.View
   845	            collapsable={false}
   846	            renderToHardwareTextureAndroid

   857	          >
   858	            <Image
   859	              fadeDuration={0}
   860	              source={cheeseboardProductsImage}
   861	              style={styles.cheeseboardProductsImage}
   862	              resizeMode="contain"
   863	            />
   864	          </Animated.View>
   865	        </Animated.View>
   866	      </Animated.View>
   867	    );

   870	  const carousel = (
   871	    <View
   872	      style={styles.carouselShell}
   873	      {...carouselPanResponder.panHandlers}
   874	      {...sharedHeaderTouchHandlers}
   875	    >
   876	      <Animated.View style={styles.carouselNavBar}>
   877	        <View style={styles.carouselStickyExpansion}>
   878	          <Animated.View
   879	            pointerEvents="none"
   880	            style={[
   881	              styles.carouselStickyExpansionFill,

   883	                transform: [{ translateY: stickyExpansionTranslateY }],
   884	              },
   885	            ]}
   886	          />
   887	        </View>
   888	
   889	        <Animated.View
   890	          style={[
   891	            styles.carouselInner,
   892	            {
   893	              transform: [{ translateY: carouselInnerTranslateY }],
   894	            },

  1005

  1016	    >
  1017	      {Platform.OS !== "web" && (

  1028	  );
  1029

  1053	      {isCheeseboardRouteTransitionActive

  1123	      ) : (
  1124	        hero
  1125	      )}
  1126	    </Animated.View>

  1128	
  1129	  if (showOnlyCarousel) return carousel;
  1130	  if (showOnlyHero) return heroOnlyLayer;
  1131	
  1132	  return (
  1133	    <Animated.View
  1134	      style={[

FILE: mob/components/PageDivider.js
============================================================

     1	import { Animated } from "react-native";
     2	
     3	import sharedStyles from "../styles/sharedStyles";
     4	
     5	const topDividerFadeScrollDistance = 240;
     6	
     7	export default function PageDivider({
     8	  expandedSpacing = false,
     9	  fadeScrollDistance = topDividerFadeScrollDistance,
    10	  fadeWithScrollY = null,
    11	}) {
    12	  const fadeOpacity = fadeWithScrollY?.interpolate({
    13	    inputRange: [0, fadeScrollDistance],
    14	    outputRange: [1, 0],
    15	    extrapolate: "clamp",
    16	  });
    17	
    18	  return (
    19	    <Animated.View
    20	      style={[
    21	        sharedStyles.pageDivider,
    22	        expandedSpacing && sharedStyles.expandedPageDivider,
    23	        fadeOpacity && { opacity: fadeOpacity },
    24	      ]}
    25	    />
    26	  );
    27	}

FILE: mob/utils/headerScrollContext.js
============================================================

     1	import { createContext, useContext } from "react";
     2	
     3	const HeaderScrollContext = createContext(null);
     4	
     5	export function HeaderScrollProvider({ children, scrollY }) {
     6	  return (
     7	    <HeaderScrollContext.Provider value={scrollY}>
     8	      {children}
     9	    </HeaderScrollContext.Provider>
    10	  );
    11	}
    12	
    13	export function useHeaderScrollY() {
    14	  return useContext(HeaderScrollContext);
    15	}

============================================================
FILE: mob/utils/openPaymentLink.js
============================================================

     1	import { Alert, Linking, Platform } from "react-native";
     2	
     3	export async function openPaymentLink(url) {
     4	  if (!url) {
     5	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
     6	      window.alert("No payment link has been added for this product yet.");
     7	      return;
     8	    }
     9	
    10	    Alert.alert("Payment link missing", "No payment link has been added yet.");
    11	    return;
    12	  }
    13	
    14	  try {
    15	    const canOpen = await Linking.canOpenURL(url);
    16	
    17	    if (!canOpen) {
    18	      throw new Error("Cannot open URL");
    19	    }
    20	
    21	    await Linking.openURL(url);
    22	  } catch (error) {
    23	    if (Platform.OS === "web") {
    24	      window.alert("Unable to open this payment link.");
    25	      return;
    26	    }
    27	
    28	    Alert.alert("Unable to open link", "Please try again later.");
    29	  }
    30	}
